model.title: Large-Scale Water Recycling Reauthorization Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D-NV)

summary.text: The bill would extend federal funding and authorization for a grant program that helps communities develop large-scale water recycling and reuse projects. It aims to support efforts to recycle and reuse water supplies on a significant scale.
